claim: Benchmark outcomes vary materially with data sampling, initialization and hyperparameter choices; comparisons should account for these sources of variation.
Algorithm rankings can be fragile to benchmark/task selection, motivating bounded benchmark-specific conclusions.
Experimental reporting should expose conditions, distributions and compute rather than only headline results.
EVOD-23–28 establish the failed motif result, independent oracle, fairness envelope, parity gates, resource accounting and artifact provenance consumed by EVOD-29.
